text:
Connor McDavid is being measured against Wayne Gretzky again. NHL.com wrote that his bid for a 200-point season is "drawing raves from Gretzky, others," and Kirill Kaprizov has joined the chase for history in Minnesota. He has 59 points in 27 games, after a point streak The Athletic's Jesse Granger called "ridiculous" before Tampa Bay ended it on Nov. 19.

What makes him different shows up everywhere. Edmonton takes 60% of the 5v5 shot attempts with him on the ice. His 240 bursts over 20 mph sit at the top of the league. Evolving-Hockey had him first among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 68% of his entries and exiting with possession 78% of the time.

The flag we put on him is the one we put on the whole Oilers top group. The team has scored 23.5 more goals than expected with him on the ice, and his 5.54 points per 60 sit above our talent range of 4.03 to 4.91. We mark him due to cool. Our season-end range is 144 to 177 points. Two hundred needs the bounces to keep coming.
headline: Connor McDavid's 200-point chase
